description: This PHP source file defines a class named Education within the OrangeHRM project. The class is a Data Transfer Object (DTO) used to represent and normalize education-related data for employees, including methods to convert the data to an array and retrieve specific fields related to education records. It utilizes traits for ORM entity management and interacts with Employee entity objects.

classes.name: Education
classes.description: A Data Transfer Object (DTO) for representing and normalizing employee education information.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Education DTO with an employee number.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts the Employee's education data into an array based on specified fields.

methods.name: getFieldGetterMap
methods.description: Provides a mapping of field names to getter methods for retrieving data.
